title: Games made with Unity: February 2026 in review
summary: Stay updated with the latest creations from the Unity community. Explore our list of standout games made with Unity in February 2026.
body_markdown:
***February went by fast. Congratulations to this year's D.I.C.E. Award nominees and winners, including* Blue Prince *,* Ghost ** Town *,* Baby Steps *,* Umamusume: Pretty Derby, *and more. And don't forget: Steam Next Fest ends today. Look out for our rundown of Next Fest demos coming soon.***


***While you wait, check out some of the latest releases from February, all made with Unity. Dig into*[Goblin Sushi](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734290/Goblin_Sushi/)** , ***run a gas station with your "fellow humans" in*[Roadside Research](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643170/Roadside_Research/) *, feed strange woodland critters their favorite snacks in*[Creature Kitchen](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097300/Creature_Kitchen) *, or unleash your inner demon in*[Dead Pets: A Punk Rock slice of Life Sim](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851720/Dead_Pets_A_Punk_Rock_Slice_of_Life_Sim/) *.***
